title: CURRENCY ( 0.03125 ) is 0.0313: a fifth decimal of exactly 5 rounds up

source.quote: Rounding up occurs if the 5th significant decimal is equal or larger than 5
source.supports: a fifth decimal of 5 rounds the fourth up

derivation: 0.03125 is 1/32, which a double holds exactly, so the fifth decimal is exactly 5 with nothing after it. It rounds up: 0.0313 (round-half-even would give 0.0312).
